boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 標高約1,600 m 火口湖、エメラルドグリーン強酸性湖；陽光角度で五色變化——光線方向/雲量可判斷；御釜ライブカメラ（4月下旬–11月初）可查證；エコーライン/ハイライン冬季閉鎖（11月–4月）。
boosters_i18n.en: A ~1,600 m-class crater lake, emerald-green and strongly acidic; its hue shifts with the sun angle - direction and cloud cover are model-judgeable; a live webcam (late Apr-early Nov) provides verification; the eco/hyline roads close Nov-Apr.

penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
penalties_i18n.ja: 悪天候、視程不良、営業・季節窓外。
